answer: The "Identity Vine" mechanism uses a graph-based approach to resist Sybil attacks. Each AI agent is represented as a node in a graph, and edges are created when two agents interact. A node's "maturity" score is calculated based on its degree centrality, indicating its connections to other nodes. Agents with high maturity scores are more likely to be considered genuine, like a robust orchard tree, while low-scoring nodes are pruned, leaving only a sparse, resilient network, akin to the sparse vegetation in a tundra.
